items.headline: Our Two Cents: Mid-Engine Corvette or No?
items.author: Sajeev Mehta
items.excerpt: The concept of a rear-mid-engine Corvette can be contentious in some automotive circles. Some folks love the rearward engine placement, and indeed, the C8 Corvette has an impressive level of performance and poise. Even Zora wanted the switch. However, others contend that the C8 Corvette’s departure from a front-engine architecture is akin to betrayal.
